title: Social Worker
description: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker (AMHSW) I'm a bilingual (English/Mandarin) therapist offering EMDR therapy through my Melbourne private practice, Integral Heart Therapy. name: Chelsea Bloom
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: She offers attachment-focussed EMDR as her primary therapeutic offering, and she also draws on Emotion Focussed Therapy, Schema Therapy, and Coaching Psychology to meet each client’s unique needs and goals. For clients experiencing eating disorders, in addition to EMDR (EMDR only where medically appropriate) she also offers CBT-Extended (CBT-E) and Interpersonal Psychotherapy (IPT). Areas of practice: Trauma, Depression, Anxiety, Dissociative disorders, Body dysmorphic disorders, Eating disorders, Sexual or Physical abuse, Performance anxiety, Stress reduction, Disturbing memories.

name: Amanda Wiggs
title: Mental Health Social Worker
description: I’m Amanda Wiggs, an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker and trauma therapist with more than 15 years’ experience supporting adults experiencing trauma, anxiety, depression and significant life challenges. name: Madeline McKenzie
title: Mental Health Social Worker
description: I use EMDR to support women who feel stuck in cycles of perfectionism, people-pleasing, intellectualising, and burnout. EMDR helps bridge the gap between logically knowing they are “good enough” and actually feeling it. My approach integrates EMDR with parts-informed work and nervous system awareness, supporting clients to process formative experiences where they learned that their needs, voice, or authenticity were unsafe. Areas of practice: Addiction, Trauma, Pregnancy/Prenatal/Postpartum, Anxiety, Panic attacks, Personality disorders, Body dysmorphic disorders, Eating disorders, Sexual or Physical abuse.
